lines.text: A newly married man is free from war for one year, and millstones may not be taken as security.
Israel must follow the Levitical priests on skin diseases and remember what the LORD did to Aaron on the journey.
A poor man's cloak is returned by sunset, and a poor hired hand is paid each day before sunset.
A guilty man who deserves a beating may receive no more than thirty lashes.
Moses tells Israel to blot out the memory of Amalek, who attacked the stragglers on the journey from Egypt.
